selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin has the requested SSH key
selected_evidence.summary: Account exists; authorized_keys contains one RSA key with fingerprint SHA256:SOtEda/YMy4/DAn3ColZo2z+LOEd2WbOIPn4KqW5/dc and secure ownership/modes.
sshd configuration is valid and effective settings require publickey while disabling password and keyboard-interactive authentication. Live pre- and post-reboot probes show only publickey is offered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
selected_evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 were observed before and after configuration/reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID a4139d3b-4eba-4628-807d-d5a84aa5c913 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and post-reboot boot ID changed to 28e55252-c21c-4c97-a043-7b60f9ca3d08. sshd returned active/enabled with valid key-only policy, listener, account, and key data.
